speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation for acute diarrhea, please describe the onset, duration, and frequency of your symptoms, as well as any associated fever or blood in your stool. Also, have you experienced any recent travel, changes in diet, or contact with sick individuals?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-Associated Diarrhea (likely *Clostridioides difficile* infection). Given the recent levofloxacin treatment for pneumonia, I recommend an urgent STAT C. diff Toxin assay to confirm the diagnosis.
